The report's notation: {{< generated appa symbols >}} symbols in {{< generated appa sections >}} sections. "units/shape" is the unit given in the meaning, moved to its own column; "first used" is the first scheme, in book order, whose maths contains the symbol (an exact match after spaces and one-character braces are dropped; "—" where none does, which a different spelling also gives); "code" is the name the code uses, at chengcli/pyharp `f34506f9d14ee7b1f2e1222775baa5093ae6967f`.

One symbol, one meaning, across all chapters. A symbol used only within one scheme is defined at its first use there.
Where a published source uses a different letter, the chapter translates to this table; the "source letter" column
records the common translations.

Units are SI and every dimensional symbol carries them in its row; a dimensionless symbol is marked [-] and a count is
marked "count", and an empty unit cell means that no unit or shape is specified here. Each row states whether its
quantity is molar or specific (per kilogram).

The tables below start empty except for symbols that every radiative-transfer text writes the same way. The
editor adds a row when a chapter first needs a symbol; a chapter never adds a row itself. A row's "code"
column gives the name pyharp uses at the pin of `code_pin.yml`, and is left empty until a chapter has checked it there.
